fomod.Name: Kitty Follower
fomod.Author: AugustNNEC
fomod.Description:
Standalone custom race follower. Everything is bundled - only Skyrim, Dawnguard, Hearthfires and Dragonborn are required.
Also includes optional appearance replacers for M'rissi and Sa'chil, and an optional OBody patch with BodySlide preset and PDA auto-assignment.
